India Defeats Thailand by 94 Runs in Women's T20 Asia Cup Match

The Indian women's cricket team secured a 94-run victory against Thailand in the Women's T20 Asia Cup. While the batters' performance was described as disappointing, the bowlers were instrumental in achieving the win. Shafali Verma and the spinners played key roles in India's dominant performance. The match was part of the ongoing Women's T20 Asia Cup tournament.
